CFML Language Reference: Functions

RemoveChars

Removes a given number of characters from a string, starting at a given position.

Category

String functions

Syntax

RemoveChars(string, start, count)

Parameters

string
The source string.
start
Position of the first character to remove. Must be within the string.
count
How many characters to remove. If more characters are asked for than remain, everything from start to the end is removed.

Returns

The string with the characters removed.

Usage

A start position less than 1 or greater than the length of the string causes an error. Insert puts characters in; Replace swaps text by content rather than position.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Card = "4111-1111-1111-1111">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Original: #Card#</P>
<P>Without the dashes, the hard way:
#RemoveChars(RemoveChars(RemoveChars(Card, 15, 1), 10, 1), 5, 1)#</P>
<P>Everything after the first group removed: #RemoveChars(Card, 5, 100)#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>
